setup-worker-tags-farm.run: cd "${SPECTRACUT_REPO:-$HOME/Projects/SpectraCut}" && uv run python -c "from spectracut.queue.flamenco import FlamencoClient as C; c=C('http://100.105.62.23:8085'); [print('tagged', w.name, ','.join(sorted(t.name for t in c.worker_tags_of(w.id)))) for w in c.list_workers() if w.name in ('legion', 'mrdubey-1')]" | sort

setup-signing-trust-flamenco-e2e.run: cd "${SPECTRACUT_REPO:-$HOME/Projects/SpectraCut}" && env -u SPECTRACUT_JOB_SIGNING_KEY SPECTRACUT_E2E=1 SPECTRACUT_FLAMENCO_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8085 SPECTRACUT_FLAMENCO_TAGS=3070laptopgpu,4070ti SPECTRACUT_FLAMENCO_SHARED=/srv/flamenco uv run pytest -q -m e2e tests/host/test_host_e2e.py -k flamenco
